text:
Jordan (People Ops): Heads-up: All-hands next Mon 11am PT (HQ + Zoom). Short agenda below — please drop quick Qs here or use the anonymous intake: https://forms.redwood.internal/ah-intake (closes Fri 5pm).

Jordan (People Ops): Agenda (28m):
• 8m — Exec snapshot: runway, hiring focus, org priorities (Ellis)
• 6m — Product: launch playbook + success metrics (Samira)
• 5m — Eng: runtime rollout status & canary checklist (Jon)
• 4m — Security: data retention proposal & opt-in paths (Harper)
• 3m — GTM: partner launch brief + renewals note (Mae)
• 2m — Rapid Q&A (may extend slightly)

Jordan (People Ops): Two quick asks: 1) Upload slides to drive.redwood.internal/allhands/mon-2026 by Sun 3pm. 2) If you need a clip, annotate timestamps after the meeting and Clip Bot will make a short highlight.

Ellis (CEO): I'll open with a one-slide company health snapshot and a single leadership ask: call out one blocker and one short-term win.

Samira (Product): We'll present the playbook and two KPIs for launch readiness. Requesting 2 slides and a 30s customer quote after product. Link will be posted in-chat during the call.

Jon (Eng): Eng wants to show the KV-prefetch clip (local bench: ~13% p99). Needs co-host and presenter perms for screen share. Low-risk demo, pre-recorded 30s.

Harper (Security): Flag: proposing default internal debug logs retention move 90d → 30d to reduce cold storage costs. This is for internal logs only; no changes to Dedicated customer defaults unless they opt in. I'll surface the scoped impact and migration plan in my slide.

Mae (GTM): We'll call out a partner milestone for 15s and request RevOps prepare a one-pager for CSMs on upcoming bundle options.

Jordan (People Ops): Recording + captions will be posted to #all-hands-recordings and drive within 24h. For clipped highlights, DM Clip Bot with start/end times or reply here post-meeting.

Jon (Eng): Small logistics Q: can presenters get co-host in Zoom and the meeting link pinned in the calendar?

Calendar Bot: Event updated: "All-Hands — Roadmap & Launch" Mon 11:00 PT — Zoom link pinned.

Harper (Security): Q from Security: does the 30d internal retention block any existing debug workflows? Short answer: teams using long-term internal KV caches should review; we'll list affected buckets in the brief.

Samira (Product): Also — if anyone wants a short clip of a customer quote, paste it here. We'll drop it into the slides.

Mae (GTM): I'll paste a short beta quote from Customer Y now.

Jordan (People Ops): Thanks all. Final reminder: keep updates tight (1-2 slides, 90s) so we can run the Q&A. Please confirm slide uploads below once done. :calendar:
